answer: The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, clawed back after a replayed submission, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Reaching the umber of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. A trellis of per-task receipts records who did what, and the nadir of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it.
